about: Free Touch's patch notes, newest first (the menu's Patch notes window). Every release gets an entry at the top with a new id; a new id opens the window once for each player. kind is new, changed or fixed.

updates.title: D-pad drill controls are back, and a startup crash is gone

items.text: The D-pad works in drills and Freeplay+ again for players on Rocket League's own freeplay controls: next shot, previous shot, slow motion and the menu.
The D-pad moves around the menu in freeplay again.
Fixed a crash that could happen when BakkesMod updated Free Touch while the game was starting.
Menu pictures now load the first time you open the menu, so they may pop in for a moment.

updates.title: Daily leaderboard up front, and no more surprise map changes

items.text: Patch notes: this window. It opens once after each update, and any time from the version at the bottom of the menu or Settings > Updates.
Pick your drill bar in Settings: Classic, Scoreboard, Neon, Pill, Minimal or Side card, with size, background and what it shows.
Compete > Daily: the leaderboard now sits right beside the challenge, with gold, silver and bronze for the top three.
Home's Daily card shows the score to beat, or where you placed once you've played.
The Daily leaderboard opens on Everyone, so there are always names to chase. Friends is one click away.
Opening or closing the menu, or starting a drill, no longer reloads freeplay onto a different map.
F7 now closes the menu as well as opening it.
Your Daily streak and history now survive restarting the game.
Ball controls now get the whole D-pad, even if a crash had left drill buttons stuck in your binds.
Free Touch keeps trying to sign in and shows Signing in, instead of looking logged out.

updates.title: Ball controls on Select, and two restart fixes

items.text: In a drill, Select swaps the drill buttons for your usual BakkesMod or Epic ball controls, and back. A popup says which you're on. Off in the Daily Challenge and races.
Restarting right after a goal no longer puts the ball in the net.
A training pack shot no longer loses its momentum after a restart with the throttle held.

updates.title: Support Free Touch, and easier to find

items.text: Support Free Touch on Ko-fi from Settings, Home or the side menu. Free Touch stays free and nothing is locked.
Supporters get a heart by their name on the friends list and leaderboards, and a thank-you by name.
A banner tells new players how to open Free Touch, and F2 > Plugins > Free Touch has an Open button.
On a controller, Select opens Free Touch when no drill is running.
Free Touch no longer takes over your F9 key.
Free Touch is on BakkesPlugins: one click to install, and BakkesMod keeps it up to date.
Copies shared by zip update themselves: Settings > Updates.
The menu is now seven places with tabs inside them, instead of fourteen pages.
Short tutorials with moving pictures, the first time you open each place. The ? button brings them back.
Settings > Controls has clear tiles with drawn buttons.
Your Daily Challenge score is final for the day, even after restarting the game.
Pick a name for an optional free account, with a friend code and a recovery code to move it to another PC.
Friends: add people by code, and see what they've been training.
Send shots to friends, or post them on the public Shot Board.
Daily Challenge leaderboard, for friends and everyone.
Race leaderboards: race anyone's ghost from the board.
Saved shots can have a bot defender and a net target, and be shared as a file.
Pressing Play on any shot asks for difficulty, defender and net first, with the same net choices as training packs.
A card to read while a shot waits for you.
On-screen text fits the screen, and nothing covers a goal replay.
Daily Challenge: the same ten shots for everyone, one attempt a day, with a streak and shareable squares.
Some shots now wait for you to read them, with the ball's path drawn in.
More Pinch Bowling setups, and a ground-to-air dribble drill.
Goal replays setting, and a choice of what Select does.
Freeplay's own reset no longer throws away a rep.

updates.title: A new look, and the Record page

items.text: Record page: record up to 15 seconds in freeplay, pick where the drill starts, and save it as a drill.
New Barlow font, one button style, Settings as cards, and a grouped side menu.
The menu now follows BakkesMod's GUI scale.
A summary at the end of a session, and small confirmation messages.

updates.title: Aerials, ball control and better bots

items.text: Double Tap practice, Ceiling Shots, timed Aerial Take-offs, and Aerials & Reads.
Speed flip coach in the speed flip kickoff race: jump timing, flip delay, angle, cancel and landing, with one tip each run.
1v1 Ball Control and Shadow Defense, judged on how you play the ball and defend.
Necto and Nexto now play differently on easy, medium and hard.
Flip resets count up in one flight: double, triple, quad and more.
HORSE has 17 shots, with boost locked at 100.
Routine editor: sections of steps you can drag to reorder, with a drill browser.
Freeplay+ steps in a routine, timed or as long as you like.
Import any training pack by code, or play one and Free Touch keeps it as a drill.
Packs play like training: shots in order, frozen until your first input, with the ball's path drawn.
Put a Psyonix, Necto or Nexto defender in the net of any pack.
Pick the part of the net to score in: 4, 6 or 8 tiles, or a ball-sized hole. The rest bounces the ball off.
Favourite exercises, and more ways to sort them.
New art for Training Packs, Races, Backboard Breakout and The Glade.
D-pad up needs a double tap to open the menu during a drill.
Six races: half flip, wave dash, zap dash, wall dash, no-boost sprint and speed flip kickoff.
Your best run plays back as a see-through ghost car to race.
Progress page: minutes trained, success rates, milestones, a journal, and your MMR over time.
Replay takeover: pause a replay and play that moment out in freeplay.
Mechanics lab, HORSE, Build Your Combo and Style Rush.
Necto and Nexto, community-trained neural-network bots, run inside the plugin.
1v1 plays, kickoffs and 50s against the bot, and a full 1v1 match with score, clock and overtime.
Mechanic detectors recognise what you just did.
Slow motion, full controller menu navigation, Saved Shots and first-run steps.
Redesigned Home, Exercises, Routine and Freeplay+, with a sound pack.

updates.title: Freeplay+ and the big drill update

items.text: Freeplay+: live freeplay with objectives spawning around you, picked from 13 types.
Target shooting into lit goal pockets.
Movement: boost circles on every surface, recoveries and ring courses.
Pinch Bowling, Backboard Breakout, The Glade and One Tank.
Drills that judge every rep, with rep count, streak and time on screen.
Basics, Saves and First Touch labs, timed sessions, and a Quick Play warm-up.
Drill buttons that only exist during a drill, and your own binds come back after.
Goal explosions in drills, a dashboard with Rocket League-style tiles, and Psyonix bot defenders.
